scope: Replace the active Stage1-before-GRPO versus GRPO-after-finetuning diagnostic entrypoint with a reward-only comparison that persists one unified per-step CSV and nine two-checkpoint reward boxplots.

user_semantics.history_policy: Interpret 全不删除 literally: no historical comparison output, report, table, chart, video, evaluator, or test was deleted. The new output is isolated under evaluation/reward_compare.
user_semantics.joint_trajectory_correction: The planner tensor [3,8,3] contains three vehicle trajectories that form one joint trajectory, not three independent joint candidates. The frozen joint reward already performs the vehicle/pair/joint risk aggregation, so the recorded scalar is not divided by three again.
user_semantics.row_policy: Write one row for each checkpoint, scenario, seed, and model-ready simulator step. Warm-up steps have no checkpoint trajectory and are not written.

launcher.atomic_csv_policy: Validate a process-scoped attempt CSV, then replace only the active reward_compare/step_rewards.csv. A failed or incomplete evaluation preserves the previous completed CSV.

evaluator.scenario_seed_scope: Frozen S5-S9 primary contract with holdout seeds 31 and 47 by default
evaluator.fairness: Each checkpoint receives an independently reset environment with an identical initial-state signature, initial scene, seed, and diffusion-noise stream. After the first action each model advances its own closed-loop state, which is the intended reward-distribution comparison.
evaluator.reward_domain: JointTrajectoryProxyReward.score on raw selected tau_d before KinematicTrajectoryOptimizer; optimized tau_cmd only advances the environment.
evaluator.sum_invariant: The eight signed weighted component columns sum to total_reward within relative/absolute tolerance 1e-6. unsafe and clearance_violation remain diagnostics and are not extra reward terms.

plotter.outputs: One PNG for total_reward and each of the eight signed component rewards; every figure contains stage1_a and grpo_open box distributions plus mean markers and values.
plotter.input_validation: Require both and only the two model IDs, all nine finite reward columns, and at least one row per model.

focused_regression.warning_classification: Existing NumPy compatibility, Gym, Matplotlib/Pyparsing, and Pygame/pkg_resources deprecation warnings.
focused_regression.core_behavior_covered: The fake closed-loop main-loop regression checks warm-up omission, exactly one row per model-ready step, raw [1,3,8,3] scoring before optimization, and identical per-seed diffusion noise for both checkpoints.

bounded_cuda_smoke.interpretation: Engineering smoke only. The horizon and one-seed scope are intentionally insufficient for a final reward-distribution conclusion and do not qualify either checkpoint.

boundary.classification: Implementation and bounded integration smoke complete; default 800-step reward comparison remains pending.
boundary.next_action: When the diagnostic comparison is desired, run scripts/run_eval_grpo.sh to populate run_3/evaluation/reward_compare. Do not interpret the output as formal checkpoint qualification.
